blocks.text: Light ki polarization ki bunyadi aqsam yeh hain.
Jab electric field vector ek hi satah mein jhoole to light linearly polarized kehlati hai (Fig. 8.4a). Misal polarizing filter, jaise dhoop ke chashmon (sunglasses), se guzarti light hai.

Jab electric field daire mein ghoome, ya to ghari ki suiyon ki simt (right-handed) ya ulti simt (left-handed), to light circularly polarized kehlati hai (Fig. 8.4b). Kitab ki di hui misal CD (Compact Disc) ya DVD (Digital Versatile Disc) se mun'akis (reflect) hone wali light hai.

Linear aur circular polarization ka mel, jis mein electric field vector elliptical rasta banata hai, elliptical polarization kehlata hai. Elliptical polarization (Fig. 8.4c) mein electric field ke do ajza E_x aur E_y barabar nahi hote, aur/ya un ke phase mein kisi bhi zawiye theta ka farq hota hai. Misal stress plate ya waveplate se guzarti light hai.

blocks.prompt: Plane polarized aur circularly polarized light ke kuch istemalat likhiye (constructed response 8.1).
blocks.explanation: Plane polarized light: chamak (glare) kam karne wale polarized sunglasses aur camera filters, LCD screens, polarization pakarne ke liye polarizer-analyzer intezam, optical activity se cheeni ke mehlool (solution) ka arhaaz (concentration) napna, aur materials ka stress analysis. Circular aur elliptical polarization tab paida hoti hai jab light CD ya DVD jaisi sathon se mun'akis ho ya stress plate ya waveplate se guzre, aur light ki polarization optical communication systems aur astronomy mein istemal hoti hai.

items: Linear: E ek satah mein (polarizing filter, sunglasses). Circular: E ghari ki simt (right-handed) ya ulti (left-handed) ghoomta hai (CD ya DVD reflection). Elliptical: E ellipse banata hai, E_x aur E_y na-barabar aur/ya theta se phase mein mukhtalif (stress plate, waveplate).
